flux_scope: Four winds equally weighted, 100 ug/m3, 1 m/s horizontal, 0.01 m/s settling; each front face area, not combined front/rear or field observation.
interpretation: Vertical installations show low soiling in experiments. Present first-hit and assumed wash-off scenario cannot establish real-world long-term orientation ranking. Separate arrival, adhesion, detachment, rain removal and optical response before field calibration.
